high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from an Instagram story by Kendall Jenner, as indicated by the username "kendalljenner" at the top of the image. The post was made 13 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The setting is an outdoor stable or horse care area under a large, beige, fabric canopy that provides shade. The ground is paved with concrete slabs, and there are various items scattered around, including buckets, containers, and what looks like a bottle of hoof oil or similar product. There are two horses in the image. The horse on the left is a chestnut color with a black mane
